nom: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair SPF 30 Wrinkle Correcting Cream

segments.oily: Two reviewers with oily skin report the cream absorbs well, does not feel greasy, and works well as a lightweight daytime moisturizer with SPF.
segments.dry: Several reviewers with dry or very dry skin describe good hydration lasting all day, though one man with sensitive, very dry skin found it slightly too drying and chalky under SPF.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally report no irritation or breakouts and appreciate the fragrance-free formula, with one exception who experienced burning and redness.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report visible smoothing, firmness, and reduction in fine lines, describing it as effective for anti-aging maintenance.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visible smoothing of fine lines and firmer-looking skin over weeks to months of use, including improvement around eyes and mouth; a few say they cannot judge wrinkle effects since they have none or used it too briefly.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe strong, long-lasting hydration without greasiness; a smaller group instead found the product left skin feeling dry, tight, or not properly absorbed.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a burning sensation and redness after application, which is not echoed by others.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers note the cream never irritated their skin or caused breakouts even after months of use, describing it as gentle despite containing SPF.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports fading of dark spots after about two months of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer states the product did not clog pores or cause breakouts despite having oily skin; no other reviewer discusses blemishes directly.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cream is lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs without leaving shine, allowing it to double as sole moisturizer and sunscreen.

aspects.libelle: No white cast, layers well under makeup
Good value for amount and results

extraits.texte: I have been looking for a face cream that can repair lines and wrinkles and the same time provide protection and hydration and I found it with Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Wrinkles Correcting Cream. It is very light that allows the skin to breathe and does not cause clogged pores. Another thing I like is that it does not cause my face greasy even though I have oily skin. And it is so convenient, I don't have to put a layer of face cream and a layer of sunscreen on my face. Just one layer is enough.

extraits.titre: It is good (I still miss the old line)
extraits.texte: While this is a good product and I'm using it with good results - I miss the old line. It was better. The old line was smoother and less chalky - maybe the old line was more oil based?? This is good and still my preferred daytime moisturizer if I am going to be outside. The SPF makes it a bit thick and drying. I'm a man with sensitive, very dry skin - so this is almost too dry for my skin. But I like the anti-aging effects - it makes a difference and I see it in my face. This may just not be the best option for those of us with very dry skin - it needs to be more oil based. It's not gel-based so those with oily skin - well I don't know how this would work for oily skin either. Beyond the slightly drying effect and chakly SPF - it's still good and works well for anti-aging and seeing a smoother complexion. It is part of an overall routine - I think it is just a piece of the puzzle that makes my skin look great.

extraits.titre: Works well for my oily skin
extraits.texte: I was excited to try this new SPF cream from the Smart Clinical repair line. I really like the night creams from this line. I have had oily skin since I was a teen. I was a bit worried that this cream would be too heavy or my makeup would slide off my face in an hour. But, I was very pleasantly surprised with this new SPF day cream! It works well for my oily skin. I press it in and let it absorb before applying makeup. It is very moisturizing so I don't need an additional moisturizer on the days I use it. It brings an easy breezy feeling to my routine as far as SPF.

This cream is incredible, it sinks into the skin beautifully without leaving a white cast, it's hydrating but not greasy, and it leaves my skin looking so smooth. I really appreciate that it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or break me out. Not to mention the packaging is beautifully weighted glass and feels really substantial.

As someone in their late thirties concerned about preventing and correcting signs of aging, I've been on the lookout for a moisturizer that offers both sun protection and wrinkle correction. Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Wrinkle Correcting Cream fits the bill perfectly. The texture of this cream is luxurious yet lightweight, making it comfortable to wear under makeup or on its own. It absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving behind a velvety finish that doesn't feel greasy or heavy. One of the standout features of this cream is its wrinkle-correcting abilities. Formulated with Clinique's innovative technology, it targets lines and wrinkles, visibly improving their appearance over time. I've noticed a reduction in the fine lines around my eyes and mouth since incorporating this cream into my skincare routine. The addition of SPF 30 is a huge bonus. Sun protection is essential for preventing further damage to the skin and minimizing the appearance of wrinkles. I love that I can rely on this cream for both hydration and sun protection without having to layer multiple products. Despite containing SPF, the cream doesn't have that typical sunscreen smell and doesn't leave a white cast on my skin. It's also fragrance-free, which is great for those with sensitive skin like mine. The packaging is sleek and practical, with a pump dispenser that ensures hygienic and mess-free application.
